message.text: Tracing how derived memo metadata is computed. RebuildMemoPayload extracts tags and properties from content. I will locate the exact computation site and identify the triggering operations.
I'll trace where memo payload metadata is computed, what triggers it, and what it extracts.

UpdateMemo rebuilds metadata when content changes. The proto defines MemoPayload fields. Location is user-set, not derived.

RebuildMemoPayload computes MemoPayload tags and property fields such as title, hasLink, hasCode, hasTaskList, and hasIncompleteTasks. ExtractAll handles Mentions separately. Triggers include CreateMemo, UpdateMemo when content changes, and memopayload.Runner.RunOnce. I am checking UpdateMemo near line 447 to confirm the exact trigger condition.

The computation is performed by `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload`, which delegates to `markdown.Service.ExtractAll`. It runs on every `CreateMemo` call. It also runs on `UpdateMemo` when the update mask includes `content`.

`memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` optionally rebuilds payloads in batch, though it is not wired into production. The extraction yields tags, a title, and flags such as `has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks`, and `title`. Mentions are extracted but kept separate for notifications. Location is user-set, not computed.

h14.
`RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`) via `ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go`); `CreateMemo` and `UpdateMemo` when `content` is in the update mask (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`); tags plus `Property` (`has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks`, `title`)

Memo `Payload` (`proto/store/memo.proto`) is derived from markdown, not user-edited. `RebuildMemoPayload` parses content with goldmark and writes `Tags` and `Property`. That runs on create and on content updates. `ExtractAll` also finds `@mentions`, but those are not stored on the payload (they feed mention notifications). `Location` on the same payload is user-set, not computed. `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` can rebuild all memos but is not started in production.
